snapshot.title: Field Report: Eastfield Pump Station Pressure Anomaly

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Field Operations
fields.summary: At 05:40, I arrived at Eastfield Pump Station to verify the HMI status reported by Control Room. The on-site HMI shows all values flat-lining. The main discharge pump (BP-302) is running, but pressure at PIT-641 has not changed in 10 minutes. The local pressure gauge sight glass is cracked, so I cannot confirm the actual reading. I am unable to access the field panel due to the lockout being engaged. I am calling from my personal cell as the radio is not responding.

findings.notes: Running light active, no vibration or noise
Sight glass cracked; cannot read value
All values frozen; no update since 05:30
Sight glass cracked; fluid level obscured
RTU-07 shows 'STALE' on HMI; no new data since 05:30
No signs of intrusion; gate locked
UPS active; no power loss detected

actionsTaken: Notified Control Room via personal cell at 05:40
Attempted to access field panel; lockout engaged
Photographed cracked sight glass and HMI screen (no image attached)
recommendations: Assign a technician to manually verify PIT-641 pressure using portable gauge
Inspect and repair cracked sight glass at Eastfield Pump Station
Verify lockout status and access procedures for field control panels
Update HMI status log for Zone 2 sites
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: IMG_EFS-01 (cracked sight glass on PIT-641, HMI flat-lining)

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The cracked gauge is a red herring; the real issue is the stale telemetry and loss of pressure feedback.
